correctness.rationale: Trace of alpha^n in the etale cubic Z[t]/(t^3-t-1) has perfect pairing modulo 3. Direct alpha^13=7+12alpha+9alpha^2=1+3beta with beta a 3-adic unit proves exact unit and sequence period. The branch derivatives mod3 distinguish nine 3-adic isometries: three reducing to 0, two to 1, four to 2. Four remaining branches are fixed modulo 9 at 3,2,5,7; hence residues 0,1,8 mod9 have no singular contribution and sharp minima follow. Independent recurrence enumeration for k=1..5 reproduced (4,3,6) at k=1 and (3,2,4) thereafter, not a substitute for all-k proof.
